import numpy as np

def verify_kkt_conditions(x, grad_f, grad_g, grad_h, g_vals, h_vals, lambda_vals, mu_vals):
    tol = 1e-6
    
    stationarity = grad_f.copy()
    for i in range(len(lambda_vals)):
        stationarity += lambda_vals[i] * grad_g[i]
    for j in range(len(mu_vals)):
        stationarity += mu_vals[j] * grad_h[j]
    
    primal_feasible_ineq = np.all(g_vals <= tol)
    primal_feasible_eq = np.all(np.abs(h_vals) < tol) if len(h_vals) > 0 else True
    
    dual_feasible = np.all(lambda_vals >= -tol)
    
    comp_slackness = np.all(np.abs(lambda_vals * g_vals) < tol)
    
    return {
        'stationarity': np.linalg.norm(stationarity) < tol,
        'primal_feasible': primal_feasible_ineq and primal_feasible_eq,
        'dual_feasible': dual_feasible,
        'complementary_slackness': comp_slackness
    }

x = np.array([0.5, 0.5])
grad_f = np.array([1.0, 1.0])
grad_g = np.array([[-1.0, -1.0]])
g_vals = np.array([0.0])
lambda_vals = np.array([1.0])

result = verify_kkt_conditions(x, grad_f, grad_g, np.array([]).reshape(0,2), 
                                g_vals, np.array([]), lambda_vals, np.array([]))
print(f"KKT conditions satisfied: {all(result.values())}")
